commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rg --files --hidden -g '"'!.git'"'; cat README.md; cat docs/completion.md; cat tasklist/tasks.py; cat tasklist/cli.py; cat tests/test_tasks.py"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat docs/export-notes.md; cat CLAUDE.md; cat tasklist/__init__.py; rg -n 'COMP-|complete_task|finish_task|completion|idempotent|repeat' . -g '*.md' -g '*.py'"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
pages = [Path('AGENTS.md'), Path('CLAUDE.md'), Path('README.md'), *Path('docs').glob('*.md')]
count = 0
for page in pages:
    for target in re.findall(r'\\[["'^'"\\]]+\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', page.read_text()):
        assert (page.parent / target.split('#', 1)[0]).is_file(), (page, target)
        count += 1
print(f'Validated {count} local links across {len(pages)} documentation files.')
PY"
